notes:
## What's Changed

### Features

* **Multi-GPU select support** — Settings → GPU lists every NVIDIA card and lets you choose which one the engine runs on. (Multi-GPU inference is still on the roadmap and not yet available.)
* **Hardware check on launch** — shows a message if there is no NVIDIA driver or the driver is too old

### Fixes

* The GPU picker is usable as soon as the app opens, not only after the first model run
* With no NVIDIA card the library no longer pretends to have 24 GiB of VRAM; with a daemon on another host it no longer judges models against this machine's cards
* A conversion that has died or stalled no longer looks like a working one
* Fixed the fit estimate for dense models — they were sized as if they could offload to system RAM, so some showed as runnable when they cannot fit in VRAM
* AppImage: helper processes (installer, engine, converter) no longer inherit the AppImage's library paths
* Windows engine install no longer depends on a `uv` already on the box
* Gemma-4-26B-A4B BF16 card now downloads the instruct checkpoint, https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, instead of the pretrained base
* Some UI fixes
